findings.title: Control degradation has no edge while a digest/revocation-triggered Effect is already reconciling and unsettled
findings.requirement: PLAN §8.4 requires control degradation to commit durably and atomically fence active exposure before any later receipt, and manifest §15.6 claims exactly one safe interrupt for every active generation/exposure/Effect interval.
evidence: IC24-A sends an UNSETTLED active widening or promotion Effect to WIDENING_RECONCILING or PROMOTION_RECONCILING while candidate becomes EVIDENCE_STALE; IC32-UW/UP create the same already-reconciling shape on revocation.

IH01-W and IH01-P require the source rollout to be WIDENING_EFFECT or PROMOTING and atomically perform the transition into reconciliation, so they cannot consume a tuple already in WIDENING_RECONCILING or PROMOTION_RECONCILING.

IH01-RX/RN cover only protected X/N outcomes. Before reconciliation settles, neither classifier exists. IH06-WX/WN/PX/PN likewise require the original Effect terminal/reconciled or the complete Effect set settled.

Generic IH01 is forbidden because the tuple still has an active generation and an unsettled exposure-capable Effect. The cancellation safety allowlist does not repair a health event in the work_cancel_state=NONE trace.

The ReachableActiveExposureInterruptCoordinatesV1 equality says every member has one interrupt after X/N or unsettled classification is fixed, but supplies no unsettled interrupt for an already-reconciling source. Waiting for classification contradicts the promise that degradation durably commits before any later receipt.
adversarial_trace: Reach HEALTHY + SHADOW_PASSED + WIDENING_EFFECT (or PROMOTING) with the original Effect unsettled.
Commit IC24-A on a bound digest change (or IC32-UW/UP on revocation), producing HEALTHY + WIDENING_RECONCILING/PROMOTION_RECONCILING with that Effect still unsettled.
Before an Effect settlement receipt, deliver continuity/SLO degradation.

IH01-W/P reject because their rollout source was already consumed; IH01-RX/RN and IH06-* reject because no settled X/N exists; generic IH01 rejects the active Effect. The degradation cannot be durably recorded by any legal edge.
findings.impact: The closed manifest either drops/delays a valid control-loss event until after a later Effect receipt or requires an invented transition. This violates the declared degradation ordering and leaves an undefined safety interleaving during an externally uncertain effect.
findings.required_correction: Add exact unsettled already-reconciling degradation rows for widening and promotion. They must atomically record TELEMETRY_DEGRADED, preserve the original Effect identity and reconciliation coordinate, fence all remaining authority/sends, create no rollback before X/N settlement, and then hand off only to IH06-X/N. Include them in the exact interrupt equality and race degradation before and after IC24-A and IC32-UW/UP, plus before and after Effect settlement.
